property_summary: For any non-empty _tos and any callee, the reference C always makes exactly _tos.length external calls that succeed (so transfer returns true), whereas the mutant may attempt one extra call (accessing _tos[_tos.length]) which can revert or change call count — thus there exists inputs (including a callee that reverts on out-of-bounds call) where the mutant reverts or returns false while the reference succeeds.
change_summary: Change the loop bound to i<=_tos.length so when _tos has length n the loop attempts one extra iteration, causing a different external call pattern and possibly a different return behavior (revert) for some inputs.
